name: fit
role: the one user verb: fit(data, opts) -> Results

name: Options
role: the one settings object for fit (typed knobs with engine defaults)

name: Results
role: rich result object: solution, diagnostics, provenance, report()

name: engine.adjust
role: in-memory batch driver (batchFcn) -- fit(A,l) path in L2

name: engine.adjustBlock
role: one GLS solve over the streaming block-arrow pipeline

name: engine.adjustVCE
role: separable-GLS iteration: stochastic model <-> variance components

name: engine.adjustVCEjoint
role: Ellmer ten-step joint co-estimation with keyed arc factors

name: engine.robust
role: IRLS M-estimation over the batch driver

name: engine.solveNonlinear
role: Gauss-Newton / damped iteration over the batch driver

name: engine.makeLoader
role: day-builder -> Loader (built INSIDE fit from the data struct, R4-D4)

name: engine.synthLoader
role: synthetic ground-truth loader and raw-closure template

name: engine.BlockAccumulator
role: block-arrow accumulation with per-system Schur pre-elimination

name: engine.CommonPrior
role: prior on the common block (regularisation as observations)

name: engine.residuals
role: second data pass: residuals and quadratic forms

name: engine.gcvLambda
role: GCV choice of the regularisation weight

name: engine.mapreduce
role: serial / parfor / spmd task runner with ordered reduce

name: engine.resolveNc
role: common-parameter count derived from the systems

name: engine.selectArAcv
role: AR model selection from an autocovariance

name: engine.whittle
role: Whittle likelihood fit of a VAR model

name: kernel.decorrFactor
role: decorrelation factor of a dense covariance

name: kernel.redundancyLags
role: redundancy per lag without the dense W^-1

name: engine.runMeta
role: immutable provenance record for Results.meta (promoted from private, WP-64a)
